notes.title: New timing system + Leaderboard reset
notes.content:
Hey there!

Before we begin with the Patch Notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to become part of our community!
Send us your feedback and suggestions to help us improve the game even more and make it as good as it can be!

[url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm style=button]Join Discord Server[/url]

Thanks for playing!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Update 1.1.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New timing system and Leaderboard reset[/h2]
This update introduces a new [b]timing system[/b] with [b]3 decimal places[/b]. The previous system was unprecise and caused a lot of similar times to show up in the top 10 leaderboards.
Unfortunately, due to this change, we had to [b]reset [/b]the public leaderboards and also [b]remove [/b]local records and medal times.

[b]The old version with the old timing system is now available as a beta so you can still view your previous leaderboard times or check your medals.[/b]
[i]To access the old version, go to your [b]Steam Library[/b], right click [b]Vacuum Pilot[/b], go to "[b]Betas[/b]" and select "[b]legacy[/b]".[/i]

[i]The legacy version cannot run workshop levels or access online features like [b]multiplayer[/b] or [b]leaderboard upload[/b].[/i]

[h2]Additional changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Bug fixes
[*]Localization improvements
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Steam Winter Sale[/h1]

During the Steam Winter Sale, all of our cosmetics are [b]heavily [/b]discounted. Check out our Item Store and give your ship a [b]unique [/b]look! [b]This offer ends January 5th![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/1677570/ style=button]Vacuum Pilot Item Store[/url]

notes.title: Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
Hey there!

After a long year, Vacuum Pilot is leaving Early Access.

We have made a lot of progress during Early Access, including improved graphics, improved mouse responsiveness, online ghosts, overhauled customization options, improved User Interfaces and most importantly: A ton of bug fixes to improve the player experience.

Leaving Early Access does [b]not[/b] mean that we are done with developing the game!
We do however think that the game is now polished enough and features enough content to be considered a full game.

We will continue to work on new levels, game modes, bug fixes and other improvements to the game!


[hr][/hr]
[h1]1.0.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New XP reward algorithm
[*]New XP animations after finishing a level
[*]New Level up animations
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Early Access summary[/h1]
Here's a summary of the most important changes we have made during Early Access:

[h2]0.6.3[/h2]
[list]
[*]New Halloween Level
[*]New Halloween cosmetic pack
[*]Editor: Fixed a bug in which the selected object was not resized correctly when pressing the R key
[/list]

[h2]0.6.2[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved ship customization: Ship parts and colors can now be selected independently from one another. This means that any ship part can be combined with any color.
[*]Completing a level in Free Mode will now give a small amount of XP if no medal time was reached
[/list]

[h2]0.6.1[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to show/hide ghosts
[*]Added a new "Press Enter/Ctrl to restart" hint when crashing while the current time is beyond bronze time.
[/list]

[h2]0.6.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]10 new levels have been added
[*]Two new customizable space ships have been added
[*]Specific ghosts can now be downloaded and displayed
[*]It's now possible to watch replays of other users after downloading their ghost
[*]The in-game UI now displays all medal times of the current level
[*]Your current steam avatar is now shown in the XP card
[*]Support for more aspect ratios and resolutions
[*]The in-game text chat can now be disabled in the game settings
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to activate the mouse cursor in-game to interact with the leaderboards
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to show/hide other players
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to show/hide your current speed
[*]Editor: Objects can now be moved to the front or background by using the page up/page down
keys
[*]Editor: Objects can now be rotated more precisely by using the Q and E keys
[*]Editor: Selected objects now display their current rotation while in precision mode
[/list]

[h2]0.5.11[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved text chat
[*]Support for chinese and thai usernames
[/list]

[h2]0.5.10[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced ram usage
[*]Faster start up time
[*]Improved fonts
[/list]

[h2]0.5.9[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new "Fast start" option which speeds up the level start countdown
[/list]

[h2]0.5.7[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added new sounds when interacting with checkpoints and buttons.
[*]Editor: Fixed a crash which was caused by deleting a group of objects and then pressing R or the middle mouse button
[/list]

[h2]0.5.6[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new level
[*]Visual UI improvements
[/list]


[h2]0.5.5[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved the time it took to load the list of all subscribed custom levels within the Free Mode level selection
[*]Editor: Objects in the selection box are now highlighted before they are selected
[/list]

[h2]0.5.4[/h2]
[list]
[*]Support for custom keybindings
[*]Editor: Added a contextual help dialog that shows all available actions
[*]Editor: It is now possible to select and modify multiple objects at once
[*]Editor: It is now possible to create custom props and share them
[/list]

[h2]0.5.3[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Steam achievements
[*]Added an option to disable respawns at checkpoints
[/list]

[h2]0.5.2[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the ship to accelerate faster than intended in some circumstances
[/list]

[h2]0.5.1[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjustable camera zoom
[/list]

[h2]0.5.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved graphics and new background colors for every single level
[*]Improved Lighting and performance
[*]Ghosts of other players are now visible
[*]Added leaderboards to Arcade Mode
[*]Reduced mouse movement delay
[*]The mouse is now locked to the game window during a race
[*]Main Menu overhaul
[*]Settings Menu overhaul
[*]Editor: Added a color mixer which allows you to choose every possible color for colorable objects.
[/list]

[h2]0.4.2a[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved online multiplayer netcode
[*]Explosions of other players are now visible
[*]New color blind mode
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to become part of our community!
Send us your feedback and suggestions to help us improve the game even more and make it as good as it can be!

[list]

notes.content:

Our Season 2 content update launched a bit earlier than expected and introduces 10 new levels, entirely new space ships with their own unique customization options, a new online ghost system and a ton of quality of life improvements!

Vacuum Pilot also goes [b]Free to Play[/b] on September 23rd at 10am pacific!
([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1677570/view/3374905159847320362]Read More[/url])

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!

Thanks for playing!

[hr][/hr] 

[h1]Season 2 highlights[/h1]

[h2]New Levels[/h2]
Season 2 introduces 10 new cave and jungle themed levels, with more levels coming in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/25e42bce67b66affdc9c4a1c742a7ab6ff01fa1f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/ae95a2365aedd14248f4324d76e94c7a8ca1160c.png[/img]
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]New Ships[/h2]
Entirely new ships with their own unique customization options are now available for purchase!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/09badfaed93585912237112f66e1aa2d67d9e5c9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/902192f0802115b0aa6b61efefa32f6cc66dc3bd.png[/img]
[i]Users that have bought Vacuum Pilot before [b]September 23rd[/b] will be able to use the new ships with no additional costs! Free to play users will be able to purchase each ship for [b]$1.99[/b].[/i]

[hr][/hr] 
[h2]New Ghost and Replay System[/h2]
We have rebuilt the ghost system from the ground up. It's now possible to download and compete against specific ghosts, and additionally you can also watch downloaded ghosts as a replay.

[i]The eye icon indicates if a ghost is downloaded and displayed. Click it to toggle the visibility of the corresponding ghost.  The "Replay" symbol can be used to watch that individual replay.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/346ec78c1dfb6d8755b69c86e2b40f27eb58278a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/204791178c2c96cc97df477e72959b5e6766cdfa.png[/img]

[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Leaderboard reset[/h2]
Due to changes to the ghost system, all local records and ghosts were deleted and all leaderboard entries were removed. [b]Your XP and Player Level are NOT affected[/b]!

[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Ship customization reset[/h2]
Due to changes to the ship customization system, your space ship customization has been reset to the default.
[b]Your unlocked ship parts are NOT affected and can be used immediately[/b]!

[hr][/hr] 
[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]New content and features[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]10 [/b]new levels have been added
[*]Two new space ships are now available for purchase [i](Free for users that have bought the game before [b]September 23rd 2022[/b])[/i]
[*]Specific [b]ghosts [/b]can now be downloaded and displayed
[*]It's now possible to watch [b]replays [/b]of other users after downloading their ghost
[/list]
[h3]UI and resolution[/h3]
[list]
[*]The in-game UI now displays all [b]medal times[/b] of the current level
[*]Your current steam [b]avatar [/b]is now shown in the XP card
[*]Support for more aspect ratios and resolutions
[/list]
[h3]Level changes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Season 1 - Labrynth[/b]: Removed the start area checkpoints to improve level flow
[*]Improved the look of [b]Tutorial - Basic Movement[/b] and [b]Tutorial - Advanced Movement[/b]
[/list]
[h3]New settings[/h3]
[list]
[*]The in-game text chat can now be disabled in the game settings
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to activate the mouse cursor in-game to interact with the leaderboards. [i](Standard key: Alt)[/i]
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to show/hide other players [i](Standard key: G)[/i]
[*]Added a customizable keybinding to show/hide your current speed [i](Standard key: S)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Arcade Mode: Fixed a bug where your score was not uploaded after reaching level 10

[*]Objects can now be moved to the front or background by using the [b]page up[/b]/[b]page down[/b] keys

notes.title: Vacuum Pilot goes Free to Play + Season 2 preview
notes.content:
Hey there!

The [b]Season 2 update[/b] will go live on [b]September 23rd[/b] and will feature new Levels, entirely new customizable ships and new features!
But before we go into more Season 2 details, we are happy to announce that
[h1]Vacuum Pilot goes Free to Play[/h1]
That's right! Starting with Season 2 on [b]September 23rd[/b], Vacuum Pilot will be available for free, forever!
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Why Free to Play?[/h2]
A competitive game like Vacuum Pilot needs a healthy amount of active users to populate the leaderboards and online lobbies.
With our current business model, we did not reach enough users. Lobbies were empty and the leaderboards did not change often.
By going Free to Play, we hope to increase user activity and end up with an actual competitive environment.
Additionally, going free to play means more potential feedback to improve our game during Early Access!
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Will there be "pay to win"?[/h2]
No. The current plan is to only allow the purchase of visual elements, like new ships or ship parts.
They do not and will not change the behaviour of the ship.
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]Are there any bonuses for people that have already bought Vacuum Pilot?[/h2]
Yes. People that have bought or will buy Vacuum Pilot before [b]September 23rd[/b] will receive [b]every single microtransaction[/b] that will ever be in the game [b]for free[/b].
[hr][/hr] 
[h1]Season 2[/h1]
[h2]New Levels[/h2]
Season 2 will introduce 10 new cave and jungle themed levels, with more to come in future updates.

[i]Here's a preview[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/25e42bce67b66affdc9c4a1c742a7ab6ff01fa1f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/121337620b63e8c16054eaeece000697742c7d54.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/e2d4bd5b1d2222c9f25b88539809c0d3703be5fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/ae95a2365aedd14248f4324d76e94c7a8ca1160c.png[/img]
[hr][/hr] 
[h2]New Ships[/h2]
Season 2 will introduce entirely new ships with their own unique customization options.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/09badfaed93585912237112f66e1aa2d67d9e5c9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/902192f0802115b0aa6b61efefa32f6cc66dc3bd.png[/img]
[i]Users that have bought Vacuum Pilot before [b]September 23rd[/b] will be able to use the new ships with no additional costs! Free to play users will be able to purchase each ship for [b]$1.99[/b].[/i]

[hr][/hr] 
[h2]New Ghost and Replay System[/h2]
Until now, the game would download and display every ghost of the currently selected leaderboard.
This made it impossible to actually compete against a specific ghost, and filled the screen with a lot of ghosts, making it harder to see and focus on the level.

For Season 2, we have rebuilt the ghost system from the ground up. It's now possible to download and compete against specific ghosts, and additionally you can also watch downloaded ghosts as a replay.

[i]The eye symbol indicates if a ghost is downloaded and displayed. Click it to toggle the visibility of the corresponding ghost.  The "Replay" symbol can be clicked to watch the downloaded ghost as a replay.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/e62392ea58fc5987f96faec4d6289a44c6ebe1d4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/346ec78c1dfb6d8755b69c86e2b40f27eb58278a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/204791178c2c96cc97df477e72959b5e6766cdfa.png[/img]
[hr][/hr] 
Season 2 also includes a ton of smaller quality of life changes and bug fixes! We will go into more detail once the official Patch Notes drop!
We hope you are looking forward to Season 2 and we can't wait to see what you think!
[hr][/hr]
Send us your feedback and suggestions!

The best way to reach and talk to us is through our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url]. Here, we will create polls based on the suggestions we receive so our player base can actively take part in the direction our development is taking.

Thanks for playing!

notes.content:
Hey there!

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Improved Chat[/h2]
We have made several changes to the chat and how messages are displayed.
Previously, chat messages were displayed as a simple text, like this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/8a35ed066239b4365ed7789ba7eb9ca1b0d011f8.png[/img]

Now, the username is highlighted and shown on top of the message.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/36aaaef1491b7b80448c315458fa6bbceec0e286.png[/img]
We hope that this change makes it easier to read chat messages.


[h2]Support for chinese and thai usernames[/h2]
Previously, the game could not display chinese and thai usernames.
This has been fixed with this update.

[h2]UI fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an error in which the font size of UI elements was incorrect in some situations
[*]Fixed an error in which too many users have been displayed in the friends leaderboards, causing UI elements to be rendered outside of the visible screen
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We are currently working on Season 2 content! New levels, customization parts, new objects for the Level Editor and a new Survival game mode are in development! Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url], where we post little updates on season 2 content from time to time!

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there!

Update 0.5.0 is finally out and introduces a lot of improvements and new features!

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!

Thanks for playing!

--

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Background Colors[/h2]
We gave the game a more colorful look by reworking every single level and adding background colors!
Here is a comparison of "Industrial Zone" before and after the change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/17d73bb30c8106262260e782659d649e101b1e4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/8f4dfe578e96dfaeba63d9c56d7eca1861b1997b.png[/img]

[h2]Online leaderboard ghosts[/h2]
You can now see the ghosts of other players while playing in Free Mode!
This way, you can directly compete with other players and see how they achieved their records!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/a301a6e6875b1ced38a222577e835b26c6e47483.gif[/img]

[h2]Arcade Mode Leaderboards[/h2]
Arcade scores are now posted in a leaderboard and the Top 10 scores are publicly visible. We will add an option to compare your score to friends and rivals in a future update!

[h2]Mouse controls improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]We have fixed a bug which caused mouse movements to be delayed on some system configurations. 
[*]The mouse is now locked to the game window during a race. This is especially helpful for users with multiple screens.
[/list]
[h2]Main menu overhaul[/h2]
We gave the main menu a modernized look by moving the main menu buttons to the top and bottom of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/6f0e72d82e77b7d0769eeae665ac79edab7c8e17.png[/img]

[h2]Settings menu overhaul[/h2]
We have also improved the Settings menu and placed every available option in a corresponding category. This should make it easier to find the option you are looking for.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/32288d4771cecde352093c6dac67250aa35b37ff.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Lighting and performance[/h2]
We have fixed a problem which caused the lighting to look pixelated while the camera was moving. 
In some circumstances, lighting also caused a high GPU usage and frame stuttering.
These issues are now fixed.

[h2]Leaderboard reset[/h2]
Due to changes to the leaderboards, all local records and ghosts were deleted and all leaderboard entries were removed. [b]Your XP, Player Level and Ship customization are NOT affected[/b]!

--

[h2]Level Editor: Improved lighting color selection[/h2]
Previously, when changing the color of a light source, you were limited to a set of pre-defined colors to choose from. This update introduces a color mixer which will allow you to choose every color possible.

[h3]Previous color selection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/105bfb5d91efa3bb8ae8da1167b3277675f244ef.png[/img]
[h3]New color selection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/af541736ae6500468d41d81021447a5436dfc5c5.png[/img]


---

notes.title: What's Next for Vacuum Pilot?
notes.content:
Vacuum Pilot has been out in Early Access for over a month now. We are far from done and have worked on improvements and a big new feature. While we can't announce a date yet, we want to share what's coming soon with Patch 0.5.0! 

[h1]New Feature[/h1]

[h2]Online leaderboard ghosts[/h2]
Starting with update 0.5.0, every entry in the leaderboard will have a ghost attached to it. The game will automatically download and display the ghosts of the current leaderboard. This way, you can directly compete with people on the leaderboard and see how they achieved their records!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/152ca2a386427addfa4bbd9476f3f1adfc471ece.gif[/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Main menu overhaul[/h2]
We are giving the main menu a modernized look by moving the main menu buttons to the top and bottom of the screen.
This also gives us more space to display news, patch notes and additional information.

[h3]Work in Progress screenshot of the start page[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/cb4613f7bd305884ebf3a020f8fba22a9d5578dd.png[/img]

[h2]Settings menu overhaul[/h2]
We have also improved the Settings menu and placed every available option in a corresponding category. This should make it easier to find the option you are looking for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/e005b82698373d33144a7e237802e1a35ddfd7e7.png[/img]

[h2]Lighting[/h2]
We have identified a problem which caused the lighting to look pixelated while the camera was moving. 
In some circumstances, lighting could also cause a high GPU usage and frame stuttering.
These issues will be fixed with the upcoming update.

[h3]Current lighting (in motion): [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/4b2ce041f2d7e6e29349025fbe6aa50d6d2862e5.png[/img]
[h3]Update 0.5.0:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/0dcd15325bcf95b1f41d6cbeb35bb4f48c5e09ea.png[/img]


[h2]Level Editor: improved lighting color selection[/h2]
Currently, when changing the color of a light source, you are limited to a set of pre-defined colors to choose from. With update 0.5.0, we will add a color mixer which will allow you to choose every color possible.

[h3]Current color selection:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/105bfb5d91efa3bb8ae8da1167b3277675f244ef.png[/img]
[h3]Update 0.5.0:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/af541736ae6500468d41d81021447a5436dfc5c5.png[/img]

We hope you are looking forward to the changes that update 0.5.0 will introduce!
-----------------------------------

Send us your feedback and suggestions!

The best way to reach and talk to us is through our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url]. Here, we will create polls based on the suggestions we receive so our player base can actively take part in the direction our development is taking.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 0.4.2a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there!

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!
If you would like to see the game in your language and want to help with the translations, you can message us on Discord!

Thanks for playing!

--

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Colour blind mode[/h3]
We have added a new Colour blind mode, which displays specific symbols on top of gameplay objects like doors, checkpoints and goals. It can be enabled in the settings menu. We hope that this change improves the experience of affected players.

[h3]Multiplayer improvements[/h3]
•Explosions of other players are now visible
•We have improved the netcode, causing less visible lag

[h3]Level Editor[/h3]
We have added a new "Color block" object. This object can be used to change the background color in an area without affecting the lighting.

notes.title: Update 0.4.1a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there! After the launch of Early Access, we have received important feedback about usability and how to improve the experience for new players who are still learning the game. This small patch will focus on exactly that.

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!
If you would like to see the game in your language and want to help with the translations, you can message us on Discord!

Thanks for playing!

--

[h2]Game changes[/h2]

[h3]Easier Bronze/Silver medal times[/h3]
We have received feedback that earning the bronze medal was too hard for new players, which is why we have adjusted the time required to earn bronze and silver medals. Please let us know if the difficulty is good now, or if further adjustement is needed!

[h3]Level requirements for Arcade and Competitive mode[/h3]
Some users started with Arcade mode right away and were confused at the lack of tutorials and the difficulty. To prevent this, we have decided to lock those modes for new players and unlock them after the player reaches Level 3.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there! We have just rolled out an update for the Vacuum Pilot Demo to keep it up to date with the Early Access build which will be available for purchase later today! We hope you will enjoy the changes we made!

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!
If you would like to see the game in your language and want to help with the translations, message us on Discord!

Thanks for playing!

--

[h2]Game changes[/h2]

[h3]Improved lighting[/h3]
Colored light sources can now interact with each other and will no longer cut each other out!
We have also improved the glow and contrast of light sources, making them look more vibrant.

[h3]Smaller Changes[/h3]
•New music has been added to the soundtrack
•When selecting a new level in-game, you can now see which level you are currently playing.
•Fixed some UI errors in the german and french localizations

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there! We have just rolled out an update for the Vacuum Pilot Demo to keep it up to date with the Early Access build which will launch this month! We hope you will enjoy the changes we made!

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/RZcsmG2vSm]Discord Server[/url] to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!
If you would like to see the game in your language and want to help with the translations, message us on Discord!

Thanks for playing!

--

[h2]Game changes[/h2]

[h3]•New crash animation[/h3]
Instead of bouncing off the wall, the ship will now explode!

[h3]•New levels to play![/h3]
To provide a new challenge and to prepare you for the launch of the Early Access build, we have replaced some of the levels with new ones!

[h3]•Improved collision detection[/h3]
We have fixed an issue where it was sometimes possible to clip into walls and other obstacles.

[h3]•Support for multiple languages[/h3]
The game can now support multiple languages, starting with english and german and more languages to come!

[h3]•Smaller Improvements[/h3]
•Added fullscreen support
•Levels now have actual names, instead of being numbered
•Difficulties are now displayed in color
•Better ship colors
•Bug fixes
